purpose: Retrospective, single-AI issue routing of all non-unique cases in the immutable AI pilot v1. This is a proposed Gold policy clarification, not a Gold label release.
evidence_scope: Frozen train-only pilot left context, reading, candidates, source gold and gold segments; generation code and synthetic counterexamples. No right/future source text, holdout content, model predictions or external AI review.

A1.name: meaning_ambiguity
A1.definition: More than one meaning is supported or the bounded input cannot establish the intended meaning. Do not resolve by corpus frequency or by inventing right context.

A2.name: identity_ambiguity
A2.definition: A person, work, institution or place cannot be identified or its intended spelling cannot be established from permitted input. Familiarity is not evidence of identity.

E1.name: numeral_style
E1.definition: Numeric value and reading agree; script choice remains a style choice. Check dates, units, leading zeroes and name/quotation protection before any secondary equivalence.

E2.name: okurigana
E2.definition: Explicit okurigana alternatives need per-pair conventionality, reading and usage evidence; candidate membership is insufficient.

E3.name: kana_kanji_or_iteration
E3.definition: Kana/kanji, script or repetition marks may preserve meaning but do not prove intended spelling. No universal phonetic-equivalence rule.

E4.name: historical_glyph
E4.definition: Old/variant glyphs are style-sensitive. Do not replace modern canonical writing or normalize protected names.

E5.name: historical_foreign_spelling
E5.definition: Historical kanji rendering of a foreign name needs reading, referent and register verification. It is not automatically a modern accepted output.

E6.name: lexical_overlap
E6.definition: Different lexical items or senses cannot be admitted as mere spelling variants without explicit evidence of interchangeability in the bounded context.

P1.name: protected_name_or_quote
P1.definition: A known or possible name, title, quotation, organization, legal label or credit receives exact-form protection. This protects against normalization; it does not certify the source gold or identify the entity.

L1.name: source_language_or_abbreviation
L1.definition: Roman letters, acronyms, translations and spoken readings are not interchangeable by default. Require separate reading, meaning, language/register and exact-form judgments.

B1.name: contextual_reading_mismatch
B1.definition: The initial AI flags a reading inconsistent with the visible compound. It remains a hypothesis until reading evidence and forward conversion for the complete chosen unit are verified.

B2.name: visible_partial_unit
B2.definition: Left context and target show an internal lexical boundary. Synthetic extraction is not evidence that a user committed that prefix. Partial input needs its own declared provenance and evaluation stratum.

B3.name: unverified_right_boundary
B3.definition: A target may be a prefix of a longer unit, but right context is unavailable by policy. Never assert a missing suffix or repair it by guessing.

N1.name: context_artifact_impact_unknown
N1.definition: Visible context defects are a separate axis. Missing material does not itself prove the target label wrong or unjudgeable. Preserve both the defect and its unknown impact.

N2.name: residual_markup
N2.definition: Machine markup is directly observable. Quarantine is a proposed review disposition, not deletion or proof that ordinary non-Japanese input is invalid.

R1.name: specialized_reading_unverified
R1.definition: A domain-specific pronunciation cannot be inferred from candidate presence or AI memory; retain unknown pending a permitted authoritative pronunciation source.

prospective_gold_contract.primary_metric: Keep immutable source-exact scores and denominators unchanged; do not retroactively turn secondary semantic sets into baseline correct labels.
prospective_gold_contract.secondary_metric: Only independently adjudicated, explicitly enumerated candidate sets under a pre-frozen policy may support semantic-acceptability analysis. Report eligible and excluded counts against the original denominator.
prospective_gold_contract.unique_claim: One natural candidate is not proof of uniquely intended output. Unsupported possible names alone are not proof of ambiguity either. Record concrete plausible alternatives or leave the axis unknown.
prospective_gold_contract.input_unit: Dictionary match and forward conversion verify existence, not contextual pronunciation or realistic committed-prefix boundaries. Do not silently merge synthetic whole-unit tasks with partial-commit tasks.
prospective_gold_contract.no_deletion_for_quality: Ambiguous/noisy cases remain counted in the original cohort; quality and retention are distinct. No passing rate from deleting difficult cases.
prospective_gold_contract.pilot_only: All 1000 cases, including the 807 initially called unique, require consistent re-review before a new label version. This 193-case triage cannot certify the 807 or estimate population quality.
prospective_gold_contract.final_quality: Pilot is not final QA: point >=99.5%, Wilson 95% lower >=99.0%, independently valid final holdout >=3000 remain required; no pilot result passes Gate A.
prospective_gold_contract.safety: 0.25% safety threshold unchanged; no retraining, gate tuning or independent Test use in this triage. Freeze model/features/gate/label policy before a one-time independent Test.
